scope: Compiled Expo web UI in Chromium at 390x844, two isolated browser sessions, actual SQL functions and row-level permissions in PGlite. Synthetic auth, GPS and a local adapter for the used Supabase REST endpoints. Not a live Supabase or physical GPS test.

checks: Publish a selected workout through UI, store via real publish_workout RPC, and show it on the author Home with private endpoints omitted.
Second user cannot see follower-only post before following; Follow persists and makes the post visible on Home and after reload.
Both users can follow each other; both directions remain saved after reload.
Create a zone through UI requires explicit sharing consent, saves correct owner and publishes its event on Home.
A slower challenger receives a saved losing result without changing the owner.
Faster full-route attempt changes owner/revision and its takeover event appears on the following user Home.
An equal time keeps the current zone owner.
Overtake and extend saves longer route with original prefix intact and shows the event to followers.
Unfollow persists, removes follower-only post from Home and preserves the other user follow direction.
